name: Alerts BI workspace
summary: Local non-Git parent for the four Alerts BI repositories. This routing file and WORKSPACE.json remain outside every repository.

sources.description: Canonical design; read in full before repository work.

repositories.role: Canonical product design, contracts, accepted decisions, and coordinated release evidence.
Analysis execution, HTTP trigger, weekly scheduling, SQL persistence and migrations; producer of shared and operations libraries.
Read-only published weekly reviews through the portal_* SQL views; consumes shared only.
Authenticated operator actions and completed-run review; consumes shared and operations.

contracts.description: Pinned design, registry/API/SQL/output contracts; docs/upstream/manifest.json records commit and hashes.
One SQL migration owner. shared wheel to both; operations wheel and registry artifact to admin only.

delivery_order: Build and verify runs migrations and shared libraries
Update pinned consumer wheels and test all apps
Publish exact compatible revisions in design/releases; deployment is separate
invariants: Do not initialize Git in this parent or add submodules. Keep this AGENTS.md local. Each child tracks its own AGENTS.md.
Read the target repository AGENTS.md and complete canonical design before changes. Work across repositories requires explicit ownership/contracts.
KeepHQ and the original alerts BI checkout are outside this workspace. Preserve them.
Each application builds from its own clone and committed lockfile. Never require a parent venv or PYTHONPATH sibling import.
At most three useful subagents; no recursive delegation; lead owns integration. Do not automatically execute repository scripts at session start.
open_questions: Individual service owners and production artifact hosting beyond vendored wheels remain unassigned. No cluster deployment has been performed.
